changelog: [ADD] Initial release: a live 3D world map that opens on the map key or by command.
[ADD] Setup wizard: finds every blip your resources draw, with name, icon and position, adds the chosen ones in one go and shows where to switch the originals off.
[ADD] Blip Manager: add, edit and delete blips, categories, glow circles and areas right on the map, with fx-adminpanel, framework or ACE permissions.
[ADD] Routes with a red line, a live distance bar and a world marker; personal pins per character; town markers; player and horse markers.
[ADD] Database storage with oxmysql; tables are created automatically.
[ADD] RegisterLocations, RemoveLocations, Open, Close and IsOpen exports and a visibility event.
Fixed players getting stuck in the pause menu while the map was open or closing.
Fixed the weather staying sunny for a few seconds after leaving the map.
